$comment: The presets pnpm play:up reads (#187), and that examples/full (#184) and CI read too. `modules` is the saasaloy add list; play:up adds the database driver --db picks. `env` is written to packages/env/.env as is. BETTER_AUTH_SECRET stays unset on purpose: Better Auth then uses its dev key, which the api allows only on a loopback BETTER_AUTH_URL.

minimal.description: The base template only: the web app, no modules.

full.description: Every module with a local provider (-console, -memory, manual), so the stack needs no vendor account and no network.
